newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Islamist mayor charged with aiding rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Islamist mayor charged with aiding rebels.

text.p: A Turkish court has charged an Islamist mayor from Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan's Welfare Party with aiding Kurdish separatist rebels, judicial officials said on Thursday.
They said Behrun Aygoren, mayor of the southeastern town of Dicle, was arrested on Wednesday and charged at a night session of the state security court in the city of Diyarbakir.

Aygoren was elected as an independent at local polls in 1994 but later joined Welfare. Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas have been fighting in the region since 1984. More than 21,000 people have died in the conflict.
